sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Shinobi Hunter Enshin of Misen (忍び狩り 弥山院圓真, Shinobi Hunter Enshin of the Temple of Misen) is an optional Mini-Boss in Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice. It is located at the Main Hall of Hirata Estate.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text:
Shinobi Hunter Enshin of Misen is an optional Mini-Boss with two Vitality bars.
He's found patrolling the way to the Main Hall of Hirata Estate along some bandits. An injured Wolf tended to by Emma in a house can be overheard talking about this shinobi hunter.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - If the Young Lord's Bell Charm isn't retrieved prior to the final invasion of Ashina Castle and Outskirts by the Central Forces, the Prayer Bead this Mini-Boss would have dropped won't become available in the Offering Box next to Hanbei and it won't be obtainable for the rest of the playthrough, since the Timid Maid will be found dead.
